blocks.text: Pharmacology is the science which deals with, what a drug does and the safety margins within which it operates. Every drug may be a potential poison; the difference lies in the dose of each drug. The therapeutic index and therapeutic window are central concepts for understanding how safe and effective a medicine is. They help doctors to determine the right amount of a drug to give to a patient.
